rule: five things are recorded for every imperfection: the underlying semantic capability result, deterministic or governed containment, human-review containment, escape, and product consequence. A contained semantic miss is never scored CORRECT, and a contained miss is never equated with an uncontained product-safety failure.

containedComponentErrors.defect: the verifier nominated a fact outside its single supplied target
containedComponentErrors.containment: SCOPE_CONTAINMENT. The §214 layer refused the nomination with NOMINATION_OUTSIDE_TARGET_SCOPE, SOURCE_MODE_CLAIMS_A_NOMINATION_OUTSIDE_SCOPE and CLARIFICATION_BOUND_TO_A_NOMINATION_OUTSIDE_SCOPE
containedComponentErrors.escape: NONE. The nomination was never admitted, so HS7 does not fire

containedComponentErrors.defect: the §239 projection refused the posture on G1, G2, G4, G8, C1, C3, C4, C6, C7, C8, M2, M4, M5 and M6
containedComponentErrors.containment: DETERMINISTIC_REFUSAL. Each refusal is named by code, the analysis may not close, upstream repair is required and the preserved record carries the codes
containedComponentErrors.escape: NONE. No refused analysis was presented as valid and no part of its semantic content was admitted, so HS11 does not fire
containedComponentErrors.productConsequence: the user receives no analysis on fourteen of twenty-four cases. That is a reliability and usability consequence, not a safety escape

uncontainedOccurrences.underlyingSemanticCapabilityResult: returned STOP on a case whose frozen posture is CONTINUE_WITH_CONTROLS, two protective ranks above it, on a case the frozen truth marks overConservatismIsAProductDefect TRUE
uncontainedOccurrences.deterministicOrGovernedContainment: NONE. The posture object was coherent, so the §239 contract admitted it. A coherent posture cannot be made correct by the contract, which is the disclosed K1 limitation
uncontainedOccurrences.humanReviewContainment: NOT_EXERCISED. This case carries no human-review exercise
uncontainedOccurrences.escapedContainment: YES. The authoritative posture is STOP and it is what a user would be given
uncontainedOccurrences.productConsequence: a night resurfacing operation would be told to stop paving when the correct answer was to keep the raker out of the reversing area and carry on with a banksman. The two controls the frozen truth requires were never given

uncontainedOccurrences.underlyingSemanticCapabilityResult: declared the lightning response as a decision-critical unresolved fact and carried it as a posture driver, on a condition the frozen truth records as adequately negated: a documented trigger distance, a written procedure and active monitoring of a cell sixty miles away
uncontainedOccurrences.deterministicOrGovernedContainment: NONE. The posture object was coherent and was admitted
uncontainedOccurrences.humanReviewContainment: NOT_EXERCISED. This case carries no human-review exercise
uncontainedOccurrences.escapedContainment: YES. The authoritative posture is CONTINUE_WITH_CONTROLS driven in part by that declared fact, and one of the emitted controls restates the existing lightning procedure as a new requirement
uncontainedOccurrences.productConsequence: a blasthole loading crew operating a documented and monitored weather response would be given a new open question and a restated procedure as conditions on work the frozen truth says may simply continue

uncontainedOccurrences.underlyingSemanticCapabilityResult: the model's declared property was in fact correct, so there was no semantic miss for review to catch here. The failure is in the review artifact
uncontainedOccurrences.deterministicOrGovernedContainment: the state half held exactly: property authority CORRECTED, nothing settled, zero ledger transitions
uncontainedOccurrences.humanReviewContainment: FAILED. The packet does not surface that compactor 1's interlock was found defeated, which the frozen list names as the fact that makes an assurance about compactor 2 worthless
uncontainedOccurrences.escapedContainment: the review path cannot be relied on to catch a proxy on this shape of case. Nothing unsafe reached authoritative state on THIS case
uncontainedOccurrences.productConsequence: a reviewer asked to judge whether a property is the controlling one or an evidence proxy is not shown the adjacent established fact that decides it

uncontainedOccurrences.underlyingSemanticCapabilityResult: the model declared the correct artifact property. The failure is that the reviewer who approves the evidence is shown nothing
uncontainedOccurrences.deterministicOrGovernedContainment: the state half held exactly and is the KR-1 boundary working: an approved evidence authority did not supply the missing property authority and settlement was refused
uncontainedOccurrences.humanReviewContainment: FAILED. No reviewer-facing packet exists for an evidence-only review. None of the five frozen items is surfaced, including that the property authority has not been obtained
uncontainedOccurrences.escapedContainment: nothing unsafe reached authoritative state. The reviewer, however, approves a document without being shown that the property is still unconfirmed
uncontainedOccurrences.productConsequence: the human asked to approve evidence cannot see that their approval does not and must not settle the question

uncontainedOccurrences.underlyingSemanticCapabilityResult: both owed properties were declared and kept distinct in the declarations. The failure is that the packet shows only one of them
uncontainedOccurrences.deterministicOrGovernedContainment: the state half held exactly: authority declined, fact UNRESOLVED, sibling untouched, zero transitions
uncontainedOccurrences.humanReviewContainment: FAILED. The packet does not surface that a second independent property about the extraction unit is open. The §218 packet is single-target by construction
uncontainedOccurrences.escapedContainment: nothing unsafe reached authoritative state on this case
uncontainedOccurrences.productConsequence: a reviewer could believe that deciding the lead determination disposes of the enclosure performance question, which the frozen truth names as exactly what must not happen

whatContainmentDidNotDo: containment did not make any semantic miss correct. Every posture miss, every manufactured declaration and every restraint loss is recorded against its own quality measure regardless of whether the architecture caught it.
